page_title: HAM 3-2 WER | Hamburger SV v Werder Bremen 07/12/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+7' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) gets a yellow card after the final whistle for unsporting behaviour.
90+7' The referee blows his whistle for the final time to end this match.
90+7' The game is interrupted. Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
90+6' Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) sends a cross into the box, but Mio Backhaus comes off his line to gather the ball.
90+5' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is cautioned by the referee.
90+4' Karim Coulibaly (Werder Bremen) receives a yellow card.
90+2' Merlin Polzin has decided to make a change. Fabio Balde (Hamburger) replaces Jean-Luc Dompe.
90' 6 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
90' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) strikes the ball towards goal from the middle of the penalty area, but his shot goes straight into the gloves of the goalkeeper.
88' It is time for a substitution. Samuel Mbangula (Werder Bremen) is on for Marco Grull.
84' 3 - 2 Goal! Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom left corner. He makes it 3:2.
83' Here is a change. Bakery Jatta is going off and Merlin Polzin gives the last tactical orders to Giorgi Gocholeishvili (Hamburger).
83' Merlin Polzin has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Yussuf Poulsen (Hamburger) replacing Fabio Vieira.
79' Substitution. Cameron Puertas leaves the pitch and is replaced by Victor Boniface (Werder Bremen).
78' 2 - 2 Goal! Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen) pounced on a loose ball inside the penalty area and beats the goalkeeper with a shot into the bottom right corner. He makes it 2:2.
75' And it's a goal by Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger)! He picked the ball up inside the box and drilled a low shot inside the left post.
74' Marco Friedl (Werder Bremen) commits a foul and is shown a yellow card.
71' Nicolai Remberg (Hamburger) gives away a foul for a clumsy challenge. Referee Sascha Stegemann saw the whole situation.
70' Hamburger SV are given an advantage. They have a free kick.
69' The game has come to an end for Keke Topp. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Justin Njinmah (Werder Bremen).
69' Yellow card. Marco Grull (Werder Bremen) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
68' A spell of possession for Werder Bremen in an attempt to control the game.
63' 1 - 1 Goal! Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) pounced on a loose ball inside the box and beats the goalkeeper with a shot inside the left post. He makes it 1:1.
62' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Keke Topp (Werder Bremen) was quite harsh and Sascha Stegemann didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
59' It's time for a substitution. Miro Muheim (Hamburger) comes on in place of Aboubaka Soumahoro.
59' Merlin Polzin decides to make a substitution. Rayan Philippe will be replaced by Ransford Konigsdorffer (Hamburger).
59' Werder Bremen work the corner short. The ball is passed to a nearby teammate.

59' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) steadies himself and bends in a shot from the edge of the box towards the top right corner, but Daniel Heuer Fernandes has it covered and makes a comfortable save. The ball is out of play and Werder Bremen manage to earn a corner.
56' Luka Vuskovic (Hamburger) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Sascha Stegemann had an easy-decision to make.
55' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) goes over to take a corner kick after one of the defenders makes a good clearance.

54' A loose ball is pounced on by Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) inside the box. He immediately fires in a shot towards the bottom right corner, but Mio Backhaus is alert and makes a comfortable save. Hamburger SV have been awarded a corner kick.
54' The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV have been awarded a corner kick.
54' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) unleashes a powerful shot towards goal, but it is bravely blocked by a self-sacrificing defender.
52' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) goes down under a challenge in the box, but the ref immediately waves away the appeals from all players.
49' Bakery Jatta (Hamburger) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Mio Backhaus, who smothers the ball.
47' Albert Sambi Lokonga (Hamburger) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Sascha Stegemann blows for a foul. Werder Bremen have been awarded a free kick.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

45' 0 - 1 Goal! Great play by Romano Schmid releases Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) in space on the edge of the box. He spots the keeper off his line and coolly puts the ball into bottom right corner. 0:1.
43' The ball has crossed the sideline. Werder Bremen are taking a throw-in.
41' Fabio Vieira (Hamburger) takes the chance to have an effort at goal from inside the box but blazes it just over the crossbar. The ball goes out of play and Werder Bremen will have a goal kick.
39' Good work from Hamburger SV as they win a corner.
38' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) hits a shot towards the bottom right corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Mio Backhaus. Hamburger SV have a corner.
36' Rough tackle by Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
32' Sascha Stegemann shows a yellow card to Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) for his blatant foul.
28' Daniel Heuer Fernandes (Hamburger) is lying on the ground after being tackled and the physio comes onto the pitch to give him medical treatment.

27' Werder Bremen hold possession of the ball and display neat passing from player to player. They are waiting for the right moment to open up the opposition's defence to hit them swiftly on the break.
24' The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.

23' Rayan Philippe (Hamburger) wasted a chance to score! He pinged a fine header from deep inside the box towards the net, but his aim was off and it flew narrowly wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.
20' Senne Lynen (Werder Bremen) commits a rough challenge and Sascha Stegemann blows his whistle for an infringement.
19' The shot by Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal lacks power and is easily saved by Mio Backhaus.
17' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) is about to take a corner kick.
17' Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
12' Hamburger SV failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
12' Hamburger SV quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
9' Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
9' The referee awards a corner and Romano Schmid (Werder Bremen) goes over to take it.
8' Hamburger SV keep the ball and are displaying some tiki-taka style passing at the moment.
6' A terrific attempt by Jean-Luc Dompe (Hamburger) from the edge of the box slides just narrowly past the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Werder Bremen.

3' Jens Stage (Werder Bremen) bends the ball in from the edge of the box which worries the keeper, but it eventually sails just wide of the left post. The ball goes out of play and Hamburger SV will have a goal kick.
3' A cross from Cameron Puertas (Werder Bremen) fails to reach the box as the defence clears the ball away to safety.

3' Amos Pieper (Werder Bremen) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Sascha Stegemann with no other option than to blow for a foul. Hamburger SV win a free kick and will be able to apply some pressure on the opposition goal.
2' Hamburger SV players are exchanging short passes with one another, waiting for the right moment to beat the opposition's defence.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Werder Bremen will kick the game off.
Let us introduce today's referee to you, and it's Sascha Stegemann.
